ऐ: ऐ The twelfth vowel of the Nagari alphabet, or more properly a diphthong; corresponding in sound to Ei in height.
ऐ ind. An interjection of, 1. Remembering, (aye, ha) 	 2. Calling, summoning, (hola, ho, heigh.)
ऐ m. (ऐः) A name of SIVA.
ऐकध्य: ऐकध्य n. (-ध्यं) Singleness of time or occurrence.  E. एक, and ध्यमुञ् aff.
ऐकमत्य: ऐकमत्य n. (-त्यं) Consent, concurrence, sameness of doctrine or opinion. E. एक one, मत minded, ष्यञ् aff.
ऐकशफ: ऐकशफ mfn. (-फः-फा-फं) Produced by or belonging to animals with single hoofs.  E. एकशफ, and अण् aff.
ऐकागारिक: ऐकागारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. A thief, a robber. 	 2. The possessor of one residence.  E. एक one, अगार a house, affix ठक्.
ऐकाग्र्य: ऐकाग्र्य n. (-ग्र्यं) Intentness on one object.  E. एकाग्र, and ष्यञ् aff.
ऐकान्यिक: ऐकान्यिक m. (-कः) One who commits a single error in reading.  E. एक and अन्य other, ठक् aff.
ऐकाहिक: ऐकाहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ephemeral, quotidian, of one day, of the same day.  E. एक and अहन् a day, ठञ् aff.
ऐक्य: ऐक्य n. (-क्यं) 	 1. Unity, oneness. 	 2. A whole of various parts, an aggre-gate, a total.  E. एक, and ष्यञ् aff.
ऐक्षव: ऐक्षव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Sugar, sugary, produced from or relating to the sugar-cane.  E. इक्षु sugar-cane, अण् aff.
ऐक्षुक: ऐक्षुक m. (-कः) A carrier of sugar-canes.  E. इक्षु, and ठञ् aff.
ऐक्षुभारिक: ऐक्षुभारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Carrying sugar-canes.  E. इक्षु, and भार a load, ठञ् aff.
ऐक्ष्वाक: ऐक्ष्वाक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.  E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अञ् affix, the final rejected.
ऐक्ष्वाकव: ऐक्ष्वाकव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Of the family of IKSHWAKU.  E. ईक्ष्वाकु, and अण् aff.
ऐङ्गुद: ऐङ्गुद n. (-दं) The fruit of the plant called Inguda.  E. इङ्गुद the plant, affix अण्.
ऐच्छिक: ऐच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Optional, voluntary, at will.  E. इच्छा wish, ठञ् aff.
ऐडुक: ऐडुक n. (-कं) A wall, &c. of bones and rubbish: see एडुक.
ऐण: ऐण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Belonging to a male antelope.  E. एण an antelope, अण् aff.
ऐणिक: ऐणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a deer, &c. 	 m. (-कः) A hunter, a deer-killer.  E. एण, and ठञ् aff.
ऐणेय: ऐणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Appertaining to a doe or the female antelope. E. एणी a doe, affix ढक्.
ऐतरेयोपनिषद्: ऐतरेयोपनिषद् f. (-षद् or -षत्) One of the Upanishads of the Vedas.
ऐतिहासिक: ऐतिहासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Historical. 	 m. (-कः) A historian.  E. इतिहास a story, and ठक् aff.
ऐतिह्य: ऐतिह्य n. (-ह्यं) Traditional instruction.  E. इतिहा tradition, ञ्य aff.
ऐन्दव: ऐन्दव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Lunar. 	 n. (-वं) The asterism Mrigasiras. 	 f. (-वी) A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. इन्दु the moon, अण् aff.
ऐन्द्र: ऐन्द्र mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्रा-न्द्रं) Sacred, or relating to the god INDRA. 	 m. (-न्द्रः) 1. A name of the monkey king BALI. 	 2. A name of ARJUNA. 	 f. (-न्द्री) 	 1. The wife of INDRA. 	 2. The goddess DURGA. 	 3. Misfortune, misery, (personified.) 	 4. The name of a plant, a kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 	 5. The constellation Jyeshṭha. 	 6. The east quarter, of which INDRA is regent.  E. इन्द्र, and अण् aff.
ऐन्द्रजालिक: ऐन्द्रजालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Deceptive, illusory. 	 m. (-कः) A juggler. E. इन्द्रजाल Deception, and ठक् aff.
ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक: ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Afflicted with falling of the hair or morbid baldness.  E. इन्द्रलुप्त falling of the hair, and ठक् aff.
ऐन्द्राग्न: ऐन्द्राग्न m. (-ग्नः) A ceremony, &c. addressed to INDRA and AGNI.  E. इन्द्र, and अग्नि, with अण् aff.
ऐन्द्रायुध: ऐन्द्रायुध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Relating to INDRA'S bow or the rainbow. E. इन्द्रायुध, and अण् aff.
ऐन्द्रावरुण: ऐन्द्रावरुण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Sacred to INDRA and VARUNA.  E. इन्द्र, and वरुण with अण् aff.
ऐन्द्रि: ऐन्द्रि m. (-न्द्रिः) 	 1. The patronymick of JAYANTA the son of INDRA. 	 2. A name of the monkey BALI. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA. 	 4. A crow. E. इन्द्र, इञ् patronymick aff.
ऐन्द्रियक: ऐन्द्रियक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Perceptible, perceived, present. 	 2. Of or belonging to the sense.  E. इन्द्रिय an organ of sense, and वुञ् aff.
ऐरावण: ऐरावण m. (-णः) INDRA'S elephant.  E. इरावत् the ocean, अण् affix of descent; ocean-born: न is changed irregularly to ण.
ऐरावत: ऐरावत m. (-तः) 	 1. INDRA'S elephant. 	 2. The same, considered as the elephant of the north quarter. 	 3. An orange. 	 4. A fruit, (Arto-carpus lacucha.) 	 5. A serpent, one of the chiefs of the Naga or serpent race, inhabiting the infernal regions. 	 f. (-ती) 	 1. Lightning. 2. A particular kind of it. 	 3. The female of INDRA'S elephant. 	 4. The Ravi river in the Panjab. 	 n. (-तं) INDRA'S bow unbent, the rainbow.  E. इरावत् water-having; that is, the ocean, a cloud, &c. अण् affix implying origin or descent; born from the ocean, (the elephant,) proceeding from watery clouds, (lightning, &c.)
ऐरिण: ऐरिण n. (-णं) Fossil or rock salt.  E. इरिन् earthly, अण् aff.
ऐरेय: ऐरेय n. (-यं) A spirituous liquor.  E. इरा wine, ढक् affix: see मैरेय.
ऐल: ऐल m. (-लः) The name of a king, also PURURAVA.  E. इला the wife of BUDDHA, अण् patronymick affix; the son of ILA.
ऐलवालुक: ऐलवालुक n. (-कं) A perfume: see एलवालुक.
ऐलविल: ऐलविल m. (-लः) A title of KUVERA.  E. इलविला the wife of PULASTYA, and the paternal grand-mother of the deity, affix अण्; also ऐड-विल, ऐडविड, एलविल, &c. ल and ड being interchanged.
ऐलेय: ऐलेय n. (-यं) A perfume: see एलवालुक.  E. एला cardamoms, ढक् aff.
ऐश: ऐश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) 	 1. Divine. 	 2. Regal.  E. ईश, and अण् aff.
ऐशानी: ऐशानी f. (-नी) The north-east quarter.  E. ईशान SIVA, as regent of the north-east, अण् and ङीष् affs.
ऐशिक: ऐशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Divine, heavenly. 	 2. Regal, royal.  E. ईश, and ठक् aff.
ऐश्वर: ऐश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Divine, relating to god, &c. 	 2. Royal, supreme. E. ईश्वर, and अण् aff.
ऐश्वर्य: ऐश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Super-human power, the divine faculties of omni-presence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. 	 2. Supremacy, dominion, away, power, might.  E. ईश्वर a master, a deity, ष्यञ् aff.
ऐश्वर्य्य: ऐश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Super-human power, the divine faculties of omni-presence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. 	 2. Supremacy, dominion, away, power, might.  E. ईश्वर a master, a deity, ष्यञ् aff.
ऐषमस्: ऐषमस् ind. The present year.  E. इदम् this, समसण् aff.
ऐषमस्त्य: ऐषमस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) Of or belonging to the present year. E. ऐषमस्, and त्यय affix; or with द्यु affix, ऐषमस्तन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं.)
ऐष्टिक: ऐष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Sacrificial, ceremonial.  E. इष्टि a sacrifice, ठञ् aff.
ऐष्टिकपौर्तिक: ऐष्टिकपौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ceremonial and meritorious, (any act, &c.)  E. इष्टापूर्त्त any pious act, ठञ् aff.
ऐष्टिकपौर्त्तिक: ऐष्टिकपौर्त्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ceremonial and meritorious, (any act, &c.)  E. इष्टापूर्त्त any pious act, ठञ् aff.
ऐहलौकिक: ऐहलौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of this world, terrestrial, sublunary. E. इह here, लोक world, ठञ् aff.
ऐहिक: ऐहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worldly, local, of this world, of this place. E. इह here, and ठञ् aff.
